discovery_articles.title: Cattedrale di San Nicolò in Noto, Italy
discovery_articles.snippet: The Late Baroque towns of the Val di Noto are a UNESCO World heritage site made up of eight towns in southeastern Sicily. Rebuilt in a style unique to the island after the devastating earthquake of 1693, an estimated 7.4 on the magnitude scale, causing around 60,000 casualties. Many towns in southeastern Sicily were completely razed, including the medieval town of Noto, with half of its residents killed by the earthquake.
